这是移动者当前区域的效果请求，不以信标存在为祝福前置。附近实体被服务和信标作为飞行偏好属于同一移动庇护政策，不把药效、移动、POI、周期、每个玩家或物种拆成参考数。底层实体遍历/完整区块生命周期和端间权威未展开。
自身hurt先调用super，只有父方法返回true且DamageSource.getEntity为LivingEntity，才先尝试移除攻击者祝福，再请求600诅咒。因果实体不等于付款玩家/最近玩家；父boolean不是本研究实测的掉血、击杀或救命回执。本类这段无额外显式server guard，完整父伤害/网络路径仍有限。
原生removeEffect的Remove事件可取消，addEffect的Applicable结果可DENY，默认同效果则update有独立返回。调用者忽略这些boolean，因此不能承诺攻击者总失去祝福/总获得诅咒，也不能把两效果视为严格互斥事务；两者共存或都不生效的许可边界保留。
效果回调：祝福清fallDistance，滑翔且仰角<-10时增加Y速度0.02+abs(pitch)/90*0.02；非滑翔且离地、不蹲伏、正下落时乘Y0.6。不是碰撞/落地安全、伤害免疫或玩家已获物品。原生MobEffectInstance按持续时间调用再递减，完整effects ticking/同步/异常监听器未验收。
诅咒对正在滑翔的Player请求stopFallFlying。对非Player，或不是同时creative且abilities.flying的Player，在离地时追加Y=-0.2；没有自动等价致死、命中或不可能逃脱结论。EffectSunbird没有自己的server guard，不能把回调的端间执行写成已实机确认。

没有新的有效候选时仍可能保留旧beaconPos，只在冷却归零分支检查旧位置有效性，且不重验64距离、owner、LOS。缓存有效信标可以绕过新搜索范围；它不是严格回巢边界、玩家专属设施或当前选中付费信标能力的证明。

observation: Actual registries and mod constructor wire CREATURE Hummingbird factory/attributes and feeder Block+BlockItem+POI. POI declares every possible feeder state, not only contents3. Forge GameData callback maps matching states; PoiManager findAll Occupancy.ANY radius64 filters actual 3D squared BlockPos distance. No POI ticket reservation/acquisition in bird code; declared ticket32/validRange6 is not a32-bird cap or guaranteed allocation.

Block player use implements one two-input facility state machine: empty0 plus tagged sweetener→2 or exact water potion item+NBT/caps→1; completing other ingredient→3. No automatic refill/random tick consumption is implemented by this complete class despite randomTicks property. Native PotionUtils creates Potion tag; exact comparison includes caps and tags and ignores count. Tags and craft/deployment not assumed.

Payment precedes unchecked setBlockAndUpdate: noncreative sweetener/water hand stack shrinks1, water path first requests glass-bottle inventory add and ignores boolean. It returns SUCCESS even if block update returnsfalse. No explicit side guard in shown use; no player interaction/cross-mod authority or double-charge runtime reproduction. Native addItem forwards inventory boolean, no guaranteed bottle return or drop fallback from this caller.

Important fixed-source resource naming boundary: AMTagRegistry declares hummingnbird_feeder_sweeteners with extra n, whereas exhaustive nontruncated pinned tree has only hummingbird_feeder_sweeteners.json and no matching misspelled path. Neither raw resource is locally read. This proves source-key/tree-path mismatch, NOT merged loaded-tag emptiness or actual sugar membership; external datapacks/mods may define matching tag. Whole policy is parameterized, no normal material availability or complete survival loop asserted.

Feeder AI and pollination are both registered priority4 with MOVE/JUMP, feeder inserted first. Native LinkedHashSet goal ordering, flags and strict-lower-priority replacement mean same-priority goals cannot replace a currently running peer; earlier higher-priority breed/tempt/follow may suppress both. EffectiveAI gate is server and !noAI; own tick cooldown updates are outside that gate. Feeder goal lacks baby guard while pollinate canUse explicitly excludes babies.

Feeder canUse first rejects sipCooldown>0. At runCooldown==0 it reuses saved feeder position if current block contents3 with no64-distance/LOS/path restriction; otherwise searches current64 POIs then chooses nearest valid by position-to-integer coordinate distance. No canBlockBeSeen/full-body/floor/path-success eligibility gate. Finding a valid source is not reachability or successful sip.

Exact failed-retry logic: when runCooldown>0, canUse decrements it, then unconditionally assigns400+nextInt600 before false return. Any failed zero search also assigns positive; completed sip does too. With only the shown methods and same goal object, later eligible canUse evaluations never reach the zero/search else again after this positive assignment. sipCooldown>0 pauses even that evaluation. This is bounded source-order inference, not live starvation/reload exploit; no claim all instances never sip since first canUse can succeed and other runtime mutations/reconstruction are outside this object contract.

Continuation requires localFeeder nonnull, current valid contents3 and sipCooldown==0, but no distance, baby or path/time budget. Movement is direct FlightMoveController wanted position; above and airborne it aims just above feeder, otherwise random nearby rise. Controller applies velocity, unused canReach helper is never called from tick, so path safety is not guaranteed.

Within Euclidean distance<2.5 and birdY>feederY it increments idleAtFlowerTime, caches feederPos and broadcasts event68. Counter does not reset simply for an out-of-range tick; interruption stop does reset. Completion strictly>55 qualifying feeder-goal updates, not56 guaranteed consecutive world ticks. Goal default requiresUpdateEveryTick=false, Mob half-phase scheduling means do not turn updates into fixed wall time. Client event68 requests optional nectar particles/sip animation only, no authoritative output receipt.

At completion, if existing CropsPollinated>2 and1/25 RNG it requests feeder contents0, ignoring setBlock boolean. Then increments SAME counter used by flower visits, sets sipCooldown120..1319, integer-divides pollinateCooldown by3 clamped at0, assigns runCooldown400..999 and calls underlying stop. Does not reset visitation counter, require actual drained state or commit a resource-use receipt. Initial two ingredients can support multiple conceptual visits but same-object retry defect/other gates preclude a guaranteed long-run economy.

Pollination uses native MoveToBlockGoal range32 and vertical8 search, with cached nextStart interval reduced(200..399). It only calls parent when adult and pollinateCooldown==0, so eligibility/flag arbitration gates retry decrement. Target is current hummingbird_pollinates tag and LOS clip; nearest algorithm is native ordered rectangular rings/restriction test, not proven shortest flight path.

Pollination tick first calls native parent tick, which adjusts tryTicks/repaths using3D center distance; override then adjusts tryTicks a second time using XZ integer-truncated AMBlockPos coordinates at targetY and strict squared<9. AMBlockPos casts doubles to int (toward zero, not floor); target from parent is blockPos.above. Own reached flag plus abs(birdY-originalblockY)<=2 permits idle accumulation; not continuous20worldtick contact. super requiresUpdateEveryTick=true; parent continuation revalidates target and time window only on full selector cleanup.

At idle>=20 it first requests levelEvent2005, increments CropsPollinated and sets pollinateCooldown200. If new shared counter>3 it conditionally calls native BoneMealItem.growCrop only when CURRENT block is CropBlock and !maxAge, then sets counter0 regardless of no crop, mature crop, false growth or denied hook. Thus four flower visits are NOT necessarily required: feeder visits use same counter; event/counter/cooldown are not real growth or harvest receipts.

Native growCrop only runs in ServerLevel using FakePlayerFactory Minecraft fake player. onApplyBonemeal cancellable hook can return-1; ALLOW returns1 without requiring default crop change and shrinks supplied stack onserver. Default path checks current Bonemealable target, native success and calls performBonemeal then shrinks; growCrop boolean ignored by mod. The supplied bone-meal stack is newly constructed and not taken from any player inventory. No real player payment, owner attribution or quest credit follows.

Native CropBlock baseline performBonemeal→growCrops requests age+random2..5 clamped max7 and ignores setBlock boolean; subclasses can override. Natural randomTick uses separate light and Forge crops-grow pre/post hooks. The AI bonemeal call is not simply the same event path, nor a guaranteed crop mutation or seed/item yield. Never split native crop/hook/feeder stages into more references.

Underlying pollination stop resets only idle; feeder stop clears local target/idle only. Calling underlying stop does not set native WrappedGoal.isRunning=false. Selector later stops on continuationfalse/flags and resets again. No automatic navigation/controller reset is added by these overrides; movement requests, interruption side effects and actual endpoint outcome remain bounded.

Own NBT serializes Variant, sharedCropsPollinated, pollinateCooldown and optional feeder XYZ; on existing object read, missingHLPX clears feeder, fields usegetInt without range clamp. sipCooldown, runCooldown, per-goal idle/localtarget and animation are not in own extra-save methods. Fresh normal constructor initializes them0; full inherited serialization/capability/mixin lifecycle and actual reloaded work fairness are unverified. No automatic restored output receipt.

Both same-priority4 feeder/pollination goals share MOVE/JUMP. GoalSelector LinkedHashSet evaluates available goals in insertion order, feeder first, and strict-lower numeric priority is needed to replace a running goal for shared flags. They cannot normally run concurrently within this selector and a same-priority peer cannot preempt an already running one; higher-priority breeding/tempt/follow and disabled flags can defer them. This is not scheduling fairness or guaranteed order of world outcomes.

Feeder runCooldown positive branch decrements then falls through to unconditional400..999 assignment/false; failed zero search and completed visit also set positive. Given only shown methods and unchanged same goal object, after any such positive assignment no later eligible canUse evaluation reaches zero/search. sipCooldown early return pauses those evaluations. Initial0 may successfully select feeder; interrupted incomplete visit with runCooldown still0 is distinct. No claim every instance can never sip, automatic retry after400 ticks, or runtime exploit.

Feeder movement issues direct FlightMoveController desired velocity toward above feeder/random rise; private canReach collision helper is not called in its complete tick. Within distance<2.5 and Y>feederY it accumulates qualifying updates without resetting simply on leaving range, saves feederPos, requests event68. At>55 it conditionally requests emptying only when old shared counter>2 and1/25, then increments sameCropsPollinated, sets sipCooldown120..1319 and divides pollinateCooldown by3. No actual drained block, consecutive tick duration or resource success receipt guaranteed.

Pollinate adult/cooldown gate delegates MoveToBlockGoal search only when eligible. Parent nextStartTick reduced interval counts canUse evaluations, not all world ticks; ring search is bounded by range32 and vertical8/restriction predicate, not nearest safe navigable destination. Target requires symbolic block tag and LOS clip. Mod AMBlockPos truncates x/z toward0 instead of floor; own XZ test is strict squared<9 with height independently<=2.

Pollination first executes parent tick and then own tryTicks update; each can increment or decrement, so net can be+2,0,-2 depending 3D versus XZ proximity, not a simple one-tick bound. Idle not cleared on every lost-proximity update, only stop; initial0 increments while<20 and next qualifying update polls at>=20. Parent requiresUpdateEveryTick=true, feeder inheritsfalse. No fixed20worldtick contact/56feederworldtick or wall time guarantee.

New count>3 triggers isGrowable currentCropBlock/!maxAge then growCrop(new BONE_MEAL stack), and always resets counter0 afterward on normal return even when no growable block or hook denial/false outcome. Feeder visits can contribute count, so not necessarily four flowers, and successful drain/growth/harvest is not recorded.

Mod ignores boolean and constructs its own bone meal rather than debiting real player inventory. No owner/payment/growth quest receipt.

Subclasses/hooks/listeners can differ. Random tick separately uses light/areaLoaded/Forge crop Pre/Post; manual bone meal is not identical callback route. Complete setBlock/chunk hooks and final changed state not proved. No item or seed harvest pickup follows this request.

Underlying goal.stop methods reset local target/idle only and do not clear WrappedGoal.isRunning. substantive_saved_judgment.trigger: 附近激活BLESSING塑像服务端消耗供品设置玩家blessing坐标/维度；能力读档恢复；最高优先级LivingDeathEvent检查后取消死亡并消费资格。
substantive_saved_judgment.input: x/y/z INT三元组、dimension整数；BLessing能力默认location=null；一次供品资格与塑像坐标。
substantive_saved_judgment.output: 完整坐标类型才恢复blessed；缺任一坐标明确清location。资格在同维度濒死事件消费，阻止本次真死亡，非无条件Clone永久进度。
substantive_saved_judgment.preservation: writer仅location非null写xyz，总写dimension；基类Clone默认!wasDead，真实死亡不自动复制。reader只检查三坐标INT，缺一置null；不检查dimension注册、目标塑像存在或仍激活。updateEffects的BLESSING每4worldtick查4格内非spectator且尚未绑定当前位置玩家，再查玩家2.5格已加载区块的SPIRIT_FRUIT供台；server随机1/40扣1供品并cap.setBlessed维度/塑像pos。onPlayerTick同维度持续给205tick blessed药效，不核当前塑像或距离。最高优先级death handler在同维度且location非null先取消事件并半血，归零经验并掉1/3经验；有一半概率寻找原位置附近有效出生点，阻塞只提示也不撤销救命，最后触发成就并clearBlessed。未检查保存坐标处现在仍是原塑像，故不能宣称源对象存活校验；清资格发生在副作用末尾，异常中断没有事务回滚证明。坐标清除后若writeToNBT复用旧compound不会主动remove xyz，但统一Clone/磁盘能力writer传新compound，因此不能把复用风险说成已证当前永不清除bug。 Master: 主责全文确认付SPIRIT_FRUIT获得维度/坐标绑定祝福，实际死亡事件取消救命后clear资格。与Anthropophagy715a的真实死亡后按旧资格复制等级不同：本项不发生Clone保留，只有未死的持久有偿资格与一次消费路径。默认!wasDead，三坐标INT guard缺任一null但维度无注册校验；末尾clear中途异常有风险。源雕像是否仍存在不验证。writer新compound可正确去坐标，不能以复用旧compound风险诬称现行持续bug。不按坐标/药效/供品拆计。
substantive_saved_judgment.application_limit: 上游经验损失/半血/复活机制是明确现有设计，本研究绝不引入Dynasty死亡惩罚或回血。主事件被取消后没有实际Clone不是永久复制成功证明。外部PlayerUtil.teleport、Potion原生持久化和事件取消顺序未展开，未运行游戏或验收救命行为。供台具体储物底层只用于定位供品，未另算实现。 固定上游源码静态审阅，不直接移植跨版本API，不宣称原生运行验证。未执行上游操作或游戏；固定TheBetweenlands MC1.12.2/mod3.9.6源码静态研究，不移植平台API或上游死亡惩罚，不等同Dynasty原生验收。
